info.title: Local Message Hub native plugin API
info.description: Experimental native versioned API. Exact localhost Host and Bearer auth. Snapshot and imported media modes are read-only and use separate route sets; isolated native-live mode adds authenticated producer ingest and durable event subscription. No browser-origin access, cookie/query credentials, or source account access. Scoped-tool grants are stdio MCP only and cannot authenticate HTTP. Not the legacy Hub API.

post.description: Native live only. Use an exact-account scoped-producer grant with only messages.ingest. Every record must explicitly match its platform and account ID or the whole batch returns 403 before storage, even on retry. An unchanged canonical decoded batch and key return the original receipt within the same archive and producer identity/scope. Receipt checkpoint is account-local incoming event high water, not a cursor. Trusted legacy producer grants still use a global checkpoint. No platform access or sends. Bounds: 100 records, 512 KiB serialized normalized records, 530 KiB JSON body; field limits use UTF-8 bytes.

One pinned read, at most 1,000 rows and 4 MiB, never a partial attachment. No media reads, file writes or global export.

Applies the same literal keyword, exact type and inclusive date filters as the scoped message reader. Existing text-only serializers plus PostgreSQL script and XLSX text-only attachments, ascending timestamp and binary ID; no media, provider or file writes. Whole request fails at 1001 matching rows or above 4 MiB output. A known conversation with no matches gets an empty export in the chosen format.
